corpus.scope: Project policies, strategy/risk/data specifications and primary-source background. No current news, future returns or hidden gold answers.
corpus.review_status: Code/source checked; independent human review and evaluation labels remain required.

entry_policy.trend_reversion: Qualified technical signal may use LIMITED/COVERAGE_LIMITED after observed research; concrete unresolved adverse event remains blocking.
entry_policy.breakout: Readable dated corroboration, source citations, breakout_support and supported adverse clearance required.

exit_policy: Cited ADVERSE_EVENT_FOUND or MATERIAL_ADVERSE holding assessment requires EXIT after independent critic and code checks; next eligible open, no forced terminal sale.
holding_watch: Bounded official issuer metadata daily for NSE portfolios; empty checks use zero generation; new candidates trigger C2 between scheduled reviews.
evidence_fixes: Currency marker boundaries and mandatory digit
Substantive subject/body context retained alongside risk windows
Routine trading-window notices excluded unless independently adverse

cached_source_inspection.observed_result: Substantive board and trading-window disclosure bodies visible; address fragments no longer selected as amounts. No new financial/adverse model conclusion generated.

limitations: No live inference replay or improved profitability claim
Coverage exception accepts residual evidence risk
Selling on small adverse events can increase fees/churn
Official daily metadata check is not comprehensive independent news
Old research fingerprints cannot resume under changed policy
